name: Clara Martin
source: Clara Martin is the strict and proper mother of Mia, a homemaker and the wife of Tom Martin, the Director of the Town Hall in Lind. She holds the dominant voice in the household, clashing with her husband’s more yielding nature. Disciplined and traditional, Clara demands excellence from her daughter and maintains a tightly controlled home.
